patches.title: rel0-4-4-os1.74: Sidecar 0.4.4 mods, OS 1.74 (default, recommended)
patches.description: The same mods as rel0-4-4, built for OS 1.74, the OS Elektron offers now: drop the stock Analog-Rytm_MKII_OS1.74.syx. Has run on a real Rytm. You can move between 1.73 and 1.74 in both directions with Elektron's stock files; recovery is the stock file of the OS you want to be on. Back up every project first. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.1-os1.74.elemod + rytm-sidecar-0.4.4-os1.74.elemod with version 1.74 (sha256 3bb035a2...0d77c). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.4 on the Pi.

patches.title: rel0-4-4: Sidecar 0.4.4 mods, OS 1.73
patches.description: The mods for Sidecar 0.4.4 on OS 1.73, for a Rytm you keep on 1.73 (Elektron offers only 1.74 now): everything in rel0-4-0, plus a held step's values on the Sidecar's SRC view (while you hold a step in GRID RECORDING, the view shows its locks and follows your knob turns on them), and the CONNECTED screen also when the Rytm boots with the Sidecar already attached. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.4.4.elemod with version 1.73 (sha256 421cccc9...acf26). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.4 on the Pi.

patches.title: rel0-4-0-os1.74: Sidecar 0.4.0 mods, OS 1.74 (older)
patches.description: The same mods as rel0-4-0, built for OS 1.74, the OS Elektron offers now: drop the stock Analog-Rytm_MKII_OS1.74.syx. Has run on a real Rytm. You can move between 1.73 and 1.74 in both directions with Elektron's stock files; recovery is the stock file of the OS you want to be on. Back up every project first. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.1-os1.74.elemod + rytm-sidecar-0.4.0-os1.74.elemod with version 1.74 (sha256 538ae6fa...ab337). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.0 on the Pi.

patches.title: rel0-4-0: Sidecar 0.4.0 mods, OS 1.73 (older)
patches.description: The mods for Sidecar 0.4.0 on OS 1.73, for a Rytm you keep on 1.73 (Elektron offers only 1.74 now): everything in rel0-3-1, plus the pan and route report master FX's through mode needs, MD's own page, the JUNO / 6-OP FM preset browser and DSP SAMPLE's sample picker on knob A of SRC, list knobs of up to 36 names, the MIDI machine (machine 50) and the arpeggiator's page (UP + FLTR); the Sidecar's SRC view comes back after a BANK tap, and a drawing race that could make the animated SRC pages flicker is fixed. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.4.0.elemod with version 1.73 (sha256 07780e9e...bff18). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.0 on the Pi.

patches.title: rel0-3-1: Sidecar 0.3.1 mods (older)
patches.description: The mods for Sidecar 0.3.1: everything in rel0-3-0, plus the fix that makes send FX follow a kit switch at once. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.3.1.elemod (sha256 a203db27...3df3c). Goes with Sidecar 0.3.1 on the Pi.

patches.title: rel0-3-0: Sidecar 0.3.0 mods (older)
patches.description: The mods for Sidecar 0.3.0: everything in rui1027d, plus projects keyed by the Rytm's slots (SAVE AS / copy / clear follow, the project trash), kits following SAVE / RELOAD KIT, NO + KIT / PATTERN reload on the Sidecar's pages, the poly sequencer's pages and keys (FUNC + YES undo, FUNC + DOWN menu), the SIDECAR MENU with WEB UI (the pairing code), and a freeze probe that reports a stuck Rytm screen to the Sidecar. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.3.0.elemod (sha256 893ed9a5...733ab). Needs Sidecar 0.3.0 on the Pi.

patches.title: rui1027d: Sidecar 0.1.0 / 0.2 mods + remote pages (older)
patches.description: Everything in sfx1021, plus the remote pages: a connect screen when the Sidecar comes up, and with TRK + YES the SIDECAR and SYSTEM status pages, SCOPE and meters, the LFO page (TRK + LFO), the REC page with playback and channel picking on the trig keys (Sidecar on the Pi) and the voice pages, in the Rytm's own font, on Sidecar Mini and Sidecar; the SRC view (the Sidecar machine's page on the Rytm's own SRC page); the Rytm's FX return on IN L/R for recording and SCOPE. The page catches only the keys and knobs it uses: PLAY / STOP / RECORD always reach the Rytm, pads, mutes, FILL and tap tempo work as usual.

patches.title: sfx1021: Sidecar mods without the remote pages
patches.description: External voice machines (PLAITS, DAISYSP, JUNO, FM, DIGIDRUM, DSP SAMPLE and user machines) on every track, the SEND FX 1/2 pages (AMPLITUDE 2; TYPE and P1..P5 with the Sidecar's FX labels, stepped lists), and the SIDECAR folder in the sample browser. The same mods as rui1027d without the remote pages.

patches.title: a4-sa12: Analog Four MKII, OS 1.56
patches.description: The A4 mod 0.12 for Sidecar 0.4.0. A track's sound can pick a Sidecar machine, whose audio comes back through that voice's analog filters, overdrive and amp; chords on any track, locks and LFOs on the machine's knobs, the Sidecar's pages on the A4's screen with UP + YES; with a Sidecar, UP and DOWN leave the keyboard's octave alone. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.3.elemod + sidecar-a4-0.12.elemod with the lock file a4156.lock.json and version SA12 (sha256 e9eab646...2a1d71). Needs Sidecar 0.4.0.
